items.message: Caller-supplied `env` keys and values are interpolated directly into `-e key=value` flag strings without any validation or escaping.

Makefile and package.json content from the repository is read and used to construct shell command tuples that are later executed; the parsing is heuristic and the resulting argv is trusted as safe by callers.
